question: Which fulfilment time is specially declared for the month of Phalguna?
premises: The reckoning of time, lunar mansion, and planet has been given for eleven months.
In the month of Phalguna a special case is declared.
That special fulfilment time is the twelfth day of the bright fortnight.
inference: Phalguna is distinguished by the bright-fortnight twelfth day as a special fulfilment time.
uncertainties: The verse presupposes the earlier eleven-month reckoning without repeating its details.
plain_english: The reckoning of time, lunar mansion, and planet has been explained for eleven months. In Phalguna, the twelfth day of the bright fortnight is declared as a special fulfilment time.
